selection.description: Overall converted GPA of 6.0 and a grade of at least 6.0 in Mathematics A to be assessed in quota 1.
Quota 2 subjects: English B and Mathematics A.

requirements.label: A qualifying upper-secondary examination

officialWording.text: International Baccalaureate (IB) med IB-Course Result på mindst 18 point sidestilles med en gymnasial eksamen, hvis ansøgeren har opnået mindst karakteren 3 i hvert af de 6 fag, der indgår i IB-forløbet. Endvidere skal ansøgeren have gennemført enkeltfag på gymnasialt niveau svarende til overbygning, jf. reglerne om overbygning i højere forberedelseseksamen (hf-eksamen) i lov om gymnasiale uddannelser.

requirements.alternativeRoute: It does not close this one to you. The Danish Agency treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with at least grade 3 in all six subjects and at least three of them at HL, as equivalent to a qualifying examination for a Danish university bachelor once you have added two successive raises in the level of upper-secondary subjects, at least one of them to A level, taken as hf-enkeltfag or as a self-study candidate. If you already hold an A-level subject other than Danish, two raises to B level are enough. Retaking to be awarded the full IB Diploma is the other published route.
requirements.note: AU’s Course Results page still mentions GSK, but national guidance distinguishes qualification supplementation through HF-enkeltfag from GSK used for programme subject levels. Confirm the individual route with AU. The rule is national rather than this university's: the Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science sets which examinations are adgangsgivende, and every Danish institution applies the same one. Two things about it are easy to get wrong. GSK (gymnasial supplering) cannot be used for this — GSK raises a subject level for someone who already holds a qualifying examination, so it meets a specific subject requirement but never raises the level of the examination itself. And the average used in quota 1 is the one from the first qualifying examination, so a Course Results holder who supplements or retakes is still converted on the original Course Results result.

alternativeRouteSummary.short: Course Results of 18+ points (grade 3 in all six, three at HL) count once you raise two subjects a level, one of them to A level. Or retake for the Diploma.

openFor.question: Will AU assess you as a paying applicant? Paying applicants cannot apply in the year they earn the IB because final documents are due 15 March noon. Check residence-based fee exemptions and your individual status before planning autumn 2027 entry.

requirements.label: English B through an accepted subject or English test

alternatives.label: An accepted English test
alternatives.note: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall and 6.0 in each section; TOEFL after 21 January 2026: 4.5 overall and 4.0 each section (older test: 83 overall and 20 each); Cambridge C1 Advanced A/B/C or 180 points, or B2 First A/180. Results must be verifiable online and supplied by the applicable AU deadline. IB study taught in English alone does not establish exemption. The planner cannot assess test scores, section results or documentary validity; AU must confirm the test evidence.

requirements.label: Mathematics at A level
requirements.subject: Mathematics
requirements.note: The 6.0 in Mathematics A that AU publishes is a quota 1 floor. In quota 2 only the subject is required.

requirements.label: Quota 1: an average of at least 6.0

officialWording.text: You must have a minimum GPA of 6.0 on the Danish 7-point grading scale in your qualifying examination to be assessed in quota 1.

requirements.label: Quota 1: at least 6.0 in Mathematics A
Quota 1 ranks eligible applicants by their first qualifying-examination GPA; any programme GPA floor applies to quota 1 only.
Quota 2 subjects: English B and Mathematics A. Documented relevant qualifications can improve the quota 2 assessment; applicants without them are assessed on subject grades.
Quota 2 relevant activities normally total 4–12 months and must be documented by 15 March. Personal statements and teacher references are not relevant qualifications.

officialRequirementsText.text: Specific admission requirements: You must fulfil the following specific admission requirements: English B. Mathematics A. B-level is the Danish subject level, not the grade. Grade point Average (GPA) requirement of 6.0 in quota 1: You must have a minimum GPA of 6.0 and a minimum GPA of 6.0 in Mathematics A on the Danish 7-point grading scale in your qualifying examination to be assessed in quota 1.

tuition.note: Historical 2026/27 rate for 60 ECTS; 2027/28 rates are not published. Non-EU/EEA/Swiss applicants with a qualifying residence exemption do not pay.

notes: AU: "The international Bachelor's Degree Programme in Data Science has limited spots and is intended for international students. Applicants with Danish A are therefore advised to apply for the corresponding Danish-taught programme in Datavidenskab as their first priority."
Current programme requirements checked on 30 October 2026; 2026 cutoffs remain historical and annual application dates remain provisional for 2027. Tuition rates for 2027/28 are not yet published.

Paying applicants cannot apply in the year they earn the IB. The EUR 150 application fee is non-refundable for applications after 1 November 2026; first-year tuition must be paid in full before the first semester. EU/EEA/Swiss and AU’s listed residence exemptions do not pay.
